facts.text: Raffles Makati is at 1 Raffles Drive, Makati Avenue, in Makati's Central Business District.
facts.excerpt: Raffles Makati is located at 1 Raffles Drive, Makati Avenue, 1224 Makati, Philippines, right in the Central Business District.

facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of the Zuellig Building and the Ayala Museum.
facts.excerpt: Raffles Makati is part of the beating heart of Manila's financial district, within walking distance of the Zuellig Building and Ayala Museum.

facts.text: The hotel is reached by taxi from Manila Ninoy Aquino International Airport.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is easily reached by taxi from Manila Ninoy Aquino International Airport (MNL).

facts.text: Raffles Makati is an all-suite hotel.
facts.excerpt: Raffles Makati is an all-suite hotel offering thoughtfully designed accommodations

facts.text: Each suite has floor-to-ceiling windows framing views of the Makati cityscape.
facts.excerpt: Each suite is designed to offer a serene escape, featuring floor-to-ceiling windows that frame mesmerising views of the Makati cityscape.

facts.text: All suites and residences include breakfast, served in Mireio or Spectrum.
facts.excerpt: All of our suites and residences come with breakfast, served in Mirèio or Spectrum with our compliments.

facts.text: Suites feature curated artwork from the Hotel Art collection.
facts.excerpt: thoughtfully curated artwork from the Hotel Art collection

facts.text: Raffles Residences Makati offers residential units with kitchens and laundry areas furnished for long stays.
facts.excerpt: Spacious one-bedroom residential unit featuring separate receiving and dining areas, well-equipped kitchen, luxurious bathroom, and a laundry area thoughtfully furnished for long stays.

facts.text: The 30-storey complex housing Raffles Makati, in Makati's Central Business District, opened to guests on 3 December 2012.
facts.excerpt: The 30-storey complex in which Raffles is housed, in Makati's Central Business District, opened to guests on 3 December, 2012.

facts.text: In 2013 the hotel started an Authors-in-Residence programme in partnership with the National Bookstore.
facts.excerpt: In 2013, a year after the opening of Raffles Makati, we started our Authors-in-Residence programme in partnership with the National Bookstore.

facts.text: Authors hosted by the hotel include Mitch Albom and Amy Tan.
facts.excerpt: The hotel has since played host to some of today's bestselling authors, including Mitch Albom, Amy Tan, Matthew Quick, Pulitzer-winning Adam Johnson, Chang-rae Lee and Ransom Riggs.

facts.text: In 2014 the hotel hosted the first Philippine Readers and Writers Festival.
facts.excerpt: In 2014 we hosted the first Philippine Readers and Writers Festival, a three-day celebration of the written word.

facts.text: Mireio, on the 9th floor, serves French and Mediterranean cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Mirèio, on the 9th floor, presents French & Mediterranean cuisine

facts.text: Mireio is named after an 1859 poem by Nobel Laureate Frederic Mistral, a tribute to his native Provence.
facts.excerpt: Mirèio is named after a celebrated poem by Nobel Laureate Frédéric Mistral. Written in 1859, the poem is Mistral’s tender tribute to his beloved Provence

facts.text: Mireio has served Provencal and French-inspired cuisine since opening in 2016.
facts.excerpt: Mirèio is an elegant brasserie-style restaurant that has been serving authentic Provençal and French-inspired cuisine since it opened its doors in 2016.

facts.text: Mistral Rooftop Bar serves artisanal cocktails with views of Makati's sunsets.
facts.excerpt: while Mistral Rooftop Bar offers artisanal cocktails alongside Makati's sunset views

facts.text: The Writers Bar and Long Bar are on the lobby level.
facts.excerpt: On the lobby level, The Writers Bar & Long Bar are signature venues integral to the Raffles experience.

facts.text: In-suite dining is available 24 hours.
facts.excerpt: 24-hour in-suite dining is also available.

facts.text: The Raffles Pool is on the 9th floor and is exclusively for Raffles guests.
facts.excerpt: Yes, the Raffles Pool is located on the 9th floor and exclusively welcomes Raffles guests

facts.text: The spa's signature treatments highlight traditional Filipino techniques.
facts.excerpt: We offer a wide collection of natural therapies and signature treatments highlighting traditional Filipino techniques and cultural wisdom

facts.text: The spa is on the 4th floor.
facts.excerpt: A 4th-floor soothing space designed to promote inner peace with natural therapies to indulge the body, mind and spirit.

facts.text: The fitness centre has city views.
facts.excerpt: The fitness centre features state-of-the-art equipment and offers stunning views of the city

facts.text: Raffles Makati is a Two MICHELIN Key hotel.
facts.excerpt: Your **Two MICHELIN Key** **_Hotel_** awaits in Makati.

facts.text: Golden Apero is the Mistral Rooftop Bar happy hour.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy Mistral Rooftop Bar's very own happy hour, Golden Apéro, from 5.00pm to 7.00pm daily.

facts.text: Golden Apero runs Saturday to Sunday.
facts.excerpt: This offer is available Saturday to Sunday, 5.00pm to 7.00pm.

contradictions.note: p5 says Golden Apero runs daily, p6 says Saturday to Sunday

sources.excerpt: Enjoy Mistral Rooftop Bar's very own happy hour, Golden Apéro, from 5.00pm to 7.00pm daily.
This offer is available Saturday to Sunday, 5.00pm to 7.00pm.
